svg.title: Hysteresis and dwell on the cold room
svg.desc: ON is requested at 2.5 degrees Celsius and OFF at 1.5 degrees; between them the request is kept. When OFF is requested at 31.0 seconds after 6.8 seconds ON, the applied state waits until 32.2 seconds. The run has 12 state changes in 120 seconds.
svg.text: Hysteresis and an 8 s dwell on the cold room
Simulator run of this project · 0.1 s samples · numbers answer the predictions
OFF requested at 31.0 s after 6.8 s ON; applied at 32.2 s, after 8 s
Waiting for 2.5 °C, then for the dwell,
